List recordings

Source: R/info.R
list_g3_recordings.Rd

Searches a folder, such as the root of the Glasses 3 SD card, for recording folders.

Usage

list_g3_recordings(path, recursive = TRUE)

Arguments

path

Folder to search.

recursive

Search subfolders.

Value

A tibble with one row per recording: recording (the folder name, as used in the recording column by the readers), path, name, participant, created and duration. A recording whose recording.g3 cannot be read is listed with NA metadata and a warning. Pass it to read_g3_gaze(), read_g3_imu() or read_g3_events() to read all recordings at once.

Examples

recordings <- list_g3_recordings(dirname(g3_example()))
recordings
#> # A tibble: 1 × 6
#>   recording path                  name  participant created             duration
#>   <chr>     <chr>                 <chr> <chr>       <dttm>                 <dbl>
#> 1 recording /home/runner/work/_t… Exam… example     2025-01-01 12:00:00       30
read_g3_gaze(recordings)
